name: SortBoard
description: Built SortBoard, a responsive React + TypeScript sorting visualizer that animates 6 algorithms in real time using generator-based execution and user-controlled playback for interactive algorithm learning.
resume_summary: Frontend engineer who built a production-ready sorting visualizer with generator-driven animations, clean React architecture, and deployable UX for algorithm education.
bullet_points: Engineered an interactive sorting visualizer in React 19, TypeScript, and Vite with 6 algorithm implementations (Bubble, Merge, Quick, Insertion, Selection, Heap) to demonstrate algorithm behavior step-by-step.
Implemented generator-based sorting flows and a reusable animation engine in custom hooks, enabling pause, resume, stop, and speed control for smooth real-time playback.
Designed modular UI components and color-state visualization (comparing, swapping, pivot, sorted) to improve concept clarity and reduce cognitive load for learners.
Built configurable controls for array size (10-100) and execution speed (1-100 steps/sec), supporting multiple learning paces and side-by-side algorithm exploration.
Shipped a production deployment pipeline with Vite build + GitHub Pages publishing, delivering a live, accessible web demo for portfolio and interview use.
key_features: Pause, resume, stop, and restart controls
Adjustable array size and animation speed
Color-coded bar states and algorithm complexity display
Responsive UI for desktop, tablet, and mobile
